name: Date calendar
description: A month on the page for choosing one date or a range, with one or two months side by side.

props.name: visibleMonths
props.description: Months shown side by side. They wrap onto two rows when there is no room.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen date (controlled). Use defaultValue when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when a date is chosen.

props.name: minValue
props.description: Earliest date that can be chosen. Earlier days are dimmed.

props.name: maxValue
props.description: Latest date that can be chosen.

props.name: isDateUnavailable
props.description: Marks days that can be focused but not chosen. They are muted and struck through.

props.name: focusedValue
props.description: The focused date, which decides the month shown (controlled). Use defaultFocusedValue when uncontrolled.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description: First column of the week. Defaults to the locale's.

props.name: pageBehavior
props.description: Whether the arrows move by all visible months or by one.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the calendar and dims it to 50%.

props.name: isReadOnly
props.description: Shows the value but does not change it.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Calendar; give it an aria-label.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen range (controlled). Use defaultValue when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when both ends have been chosen.

props.name: allowsNonContiguousRanges
props.description: Let a range run across unavailable days.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Accepts the same props as Calendar otherwise.
